That validation feels right. Empty field gave me a plain "paste a web address to continue"; typing "notes from rome" — which is just words, not a link — got a clear "this doesn't look like a complete web address, try one starting with http:// or https://"; and in both cases it left what I'd typed sitting there instead of wiping it, and didn't sneakily tack anything on to make it "work." Then the real Rome address went through fine.

That's the behaviour I'd want: it only ever starts a save from a genuine web address, so I don't end up with junk entries from a stray note I pasted by mistake, but it tells me plainly what to fix rather than just refusing, and never touches my typing while it does. Good. What's next?
